remarks: Hilltop home on an expansive 10-acre parcel of picturesque land, this stunning house offers the perfect blend of tranquil country living and modern convenience. With 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this home is designed to cater to your every need. The layout flows naturally, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for both gatherings and peaceful solitude. The well-appointed kitchen features a large eat in area with wood burning stove. First floor laundry and 1/2 bath. The first floor also has many possibilities, home office, additional bedroom, or family room. Living room. The second floor has 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The primary bedroom has a large walk in closet and a primary bath. The unfinished basement offers even more potential-for the home gym or workspace with 10 block high basement walls. Recent improvements include, Furnace 5 yrs old. Metal roof 6 yrs old. 2025 new back deck, and glass sliding door. May 2026 new stove and overhood exhaust . Refrigerator 3 yrs old, and washer and dryer 5 years old. Invisible fence (pet stop) on 1-2 acres of property. Bask in the natural light that floods through the windows and glass sliding doors off the kitchen leading to a deck and above ground pool. Enjoy lazy afternoons on either the front porch or back deck watching nature and wildlife. 1 and 1/2  car detached garage. Shed for additional storage. Seize the opportunity to make this exceptional home your own! Pembroke School District.
